name: event-control
description: EventControl — event presentation & projector control system

scripts.dev: npm run db:push && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: npm run db:push && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
